designAdjustments: Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Increased PRT-03 (Shoulder Yoke) root fillet radius to 6.0mm and wall thickness to 4.0mm to handle peak J2 bending torque.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Opened PRT-01 6808-2RS bearing pocket diameter by +0.18mm (52.18mm ID) with 45° entry chamfer for press-fit seating.
Round 1 -> Designer Revision 1: Added 0.25mm involute tooth clearance on PRT-09 spur-gear gripper jaws for smooth zero-backlash meshing.

rounds.summary: Round 1 DFM audit flagged 3 mechanical tolerance & stiffness items (6808 bearing interference fit on PRT-01, shoulder root stress concentration on PRT-03, and gear backlash on PRT-09). Looping fixes back to Designer.
fixesApplied: PRT-01 (base-pedestal): 6808 bearing pocket bore set to 52.18mm (+0.18mm radial clearance)
PRT-03 (shoulder-yoke): wallThickness increased to 4.0mm with 6mm root fillet
PRT-09 (gripper-jaw): gear tooth profile offset by -0.12mm for 0.24mm mesh clearance

issues.problem: Nominal 52.00mm bearing pocket will bind on 6808-2RS outer ring due to PETG perimeter shrinkage.
issues.finding: Nominal 52.00mm bearing pocket will bind on 6808-2RS outer ring.
issues.fix: Widen bearing pocket to 52.18mm and add 1.0mm × 45° lead-in chamfer.
issues.fixApplied: Set bearing pocket bore to 52.18mm with 45° chamfer.
